Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Growth Pathway MAP — Weekly readout & owners

Elena / Tom,

Quick weekly readout on the MAP and where we are on the expansion close timeline. Attaching the latest MAP (v3) with updated owners and dates — highlights below. Goal: keep to the 11/20 commercial close window while enabling the pilot expansion in mid-December.

High level:
- Primary objective: add two additional pilot teams (Ops + DevTools) and enable 3x usage growth on hosted inference if pilot metrics meet SLAs.
- Current blockers: finalized procurement PO + one outstanding SOC addendum item.

This week (owner):
- Procurement sign-off (Tom) — target 11/10 — ACTION: confirm internal PO owner and timeline.
- Security addendum review (So o jin) — target 11/09 — ACTION: deliver final language for data retention clause.
- Pilot onboarding schedule (Jasmine) — target 11/17 — ACTION: confirm pilot start date and kick-off agenda.
- Usage ramp playbook (Marissa) — target 11/20 — ACTION: provide recommended batch/quant config for cost targets.

Attachments: MAP_v3_AtlasHealth.xlsx (owners sheet + timeline), Security-Addendum-Atlas.pdf (redlines in comments).

Next check-in: Wed 11/04 11:00am PT — 30 min. If anything slips before then, reply here and we'll triage.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@atlashealth.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Growth Pathway MAP — Weekly readout & owners

Thanks Dylan — useful summary. Quick responses: 

- Procurement: I own the internal PO but need legal to confirm supplier contract language. Tom is looping Legal today; expect a PO draft by 11/09.
- Security addendum: I'll run the redlines past our compliance lead Eileen; can you confirm if Redwood can accept the 365-day log retention amendment we suggested?
- Pilot schedule: Ops prefers a soft-start week of 12/06 — can we target kickoff 12/06 and full pilot tech ramp 12/13?

A couple asks from our side: 
1) Can Redwood provide a short note mapping the MAP milestones to our procurement stages? That will help prioritize sign-offs.
2) Is there any flexibility on the pricing for the first-month pilot to offset initial data egress costs?

Appreciate the cadence — see you Wed.

—Elena
Head of Integrations | Atlas Health

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Elena. Short answers: 
- 365-day logs: Redwood's standard is 90 days for token-level telemetry. For your enterprise contract we can extend to 365 days with a scoped SLA and storage fee. I've attached a redline (Security-Addendum-Atlas.pdf) with the proposed language and a note on cost.
- Pilot schedule: 12/06 soft-start + 12/13 ramp works on our side. Jasmine will propose a 4-week pilot plan covering success metrics.

Action items I own this week: 
- Finalize security language for legal review (target 11/09).
- Provide quick mapping doc that maps MAP milestones -> procurement stages (target 11/06).

Sooj in
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
